records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 为配合日常需要、依据天象定出的计时系统：推排年、月、日的长度与相互关系。中国传统的这一套是阴阳合历。
records.def_en: A time-reckoning system derived from the heavens: it fixes the lengths of years, months and days and the relations among them. The traditional Chinese one is lunisolar.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.tag_zh: 历法术语 · 历代历法
records.def_zh: 同时照看太阳与月亮的历法：月从朔望定，年从回归年定，两者之差用闰月补齐。把中国的农历叫作「阴历」并不准确。
records.def_en: A calendar that watches both sun and moon: months from the phases, the year from the tropical year, the mismatch made up by intercalary months. Calling the Chinese calendar a “lunar” one is inaccurate.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.tag_zh: 历法术语 · 历代历法
records.def_zh: 只照看太阳、不问月相的历法：年的长度从回归年定，月只是年的等分。现行的公历即阳历。
records.def_en: A calendar that watches the sun alone: the year is fixed by the tropical year, and the months are merely its divisions. The Gregorian calendar is one.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.tag_zh: 历法术语 · 历代历法
records.def_zh: 只照看月相、不问太阳的历法：月从朔望定，年只是十二个月的累积。伊斯兰历即阴历。
records.def_en: A calendar that watches the moon alone: the months are fixed by the phases, and the year is simply twelve of them. The Islamic calendar is one.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 依历法排出的一年历日，逐日注出朔望、节气、干支与宜忌。
records.def_en: The year’s days laid out according to a calendar, each annotated with the phases, the solar terms, the sexagenary binomial and the day’s prescriptions.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 历书上所记的某一天：某年某月某日，附干支。历法是法，历日是法排出来的那一天——两者是两个层次。
records.def_en: A single day as recorded in the almanac, with its date and its sexagenary binomial. The calendar is the method; the calendrical day is what the method produces.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 历日之下所注的宜忌、吉凶、神煞一类文字。历代对历注的取舍不一，也是改历时争论最多的一项。
records.def_en: The prescriptions and prohibitions, the lucky and unlucky notes, the spirits appended beneath a day. What to include has differed by age, and been among the most disputed points in a reform.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 一部历法推算的起算点。上元是理想化的、各项周期同时起算的那一点。
records.def_en: The point from which a calendar reckons. The “grand epoch” is the idealised moment at which all periods are supposed to begin together.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 历法推算最理想的起算点：设想某年十一月甲子日夜半，恰好合朔、冬至，日月五星又各在其位。取上元是为了让一切周期同时起算。
records.def_en: The ideal starting point of a calendar: a year in which the midnight of a chia-tzu day in the eleventh month was at once a conjunction, the winter solstice, and the same position for sun, moon and planets. It lets every cycle begin together.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 从理想上元到本年所积的年数。这个数往往极大，唐以后渐有主张废去上元、直接以实测起算的。
records.def_en: The number of years from the ideal grand epoch to the year in hand — often enormous. From the Tang onward some argued for dropping it and reckoning from an observed epoch instead.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 一个回归年的日数。历代历法都要先定出这个数，才有后面的排历。
records.def_en: The number of days in a tropical year. Every calendar had to fix this first before it could lay out the year.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 一个朔望月的平均日数。与岁实相配，才能定出一年要插几个闰月。
records.def_en: The mean length of a synodic month. Together with the year length it determines how many intercalary months a year needs.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 太阳从某恒星回到同一恒星所历的时间。它比岁实（回归年）略长，两者之差即岁差所致。
records.def_en: The time the sun takes to return to the same star. Slightly longer than the tropical year; the difference is due to the precession of the equinoxes.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 认为回归年长度本身有增减之说。明清之际有人据实测主张古今岁实不同，这是当时主张改历的一条理由。
records.def_en: The view that the tropical year itself lengthens or shortens. In the late Ming it was argued from observation that the year differed between antiquity and the present, and used as a reason for reform.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 一部历法把一日所分成的份数。同一日长，或取九百四十、或取一万，各历不同；历中一切数值都以它为分母。
records.def_en: The number of parts into which a calendar divides one day. The same day may be cut into 940 parts or into 10000; every value in the calendar takes it as its denominator.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.term_en: method of adjusting the day divisor
records.def_zh: 南北朝何承天所创：把实测所得的强弱两个分数，按需要增减分子分母，凑出一个合用又不至太繁的日法。
records.def_en: Devised by He Chengtian: the strong and the weak fraction obtained from observation are raised or lowered in their terms until a workable, not too unwieldy day divisor emerges.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 调日法所用的两个分数：一个偏大、一个偏小，真值在其间。两者依次增减，可得越来越接近真值的近似分数。
records.def_en: The two fractions used in that method, one above and one below the true value. Adjusting them by turns yields approximations ever closer to the truth.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 由若干已知点的数值，推算中间某点的值。隋《皇极历》用等间距二次内插推日月行度，唐《大衍历》改用不等间距。
records.def_en: Reckoning a value between known points. The Huangji Calendar used equal-interval quadratic interpolation for the sun and moon; the Dayan Calendar changed to unequal intervals.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.term_en: integer and fraction of a count
records.def_zh: 历法算出的两个数：大余是整数部分，小余是分数部分。前者给出干支日序，后者给出具体时刻。
records.def_en: Every result is given as two numbers: the integer part, which yields the sexagenary day, and the fractional part, which yields the time of day.

records.group_zh: 一 · 历法・历算
records.def_zh: 唐《崇玄历》一类历法中，历中数值还须除以这个数，才得日单位的长度。与「日法」同名异实，各家用法不一。
records.def_en: In calendars of the Chongxuan type, the value in the tables must be divided by this number to give a length in days. Its name clashes with the day divisor, and its use differs by calendar.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 一年的头一天定在哪个月的哪一日。中国历史上改过多次，见 Calendar Reform 一栏。
records.def_en: Which day, in which month, is taken as the first day of the year. Changed many times in Chinese history; see the Calendar Reform page.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.term_en: the first month and the first day
records.def_zh: 一年之始的正月与一月之始的朔日，合起来指一个王朝所颁行的历。改朝换代而改历，就叫「改正朔」。
records.def_en: The first month of the year together with the first day of that month — together, the calendar a dynasty promulgates. To change them with a change of dynasty is to “correct the first month and day”.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.term_en: to correct the first month and day
records.def_zh: 新朝立国重定岁首与正月的制度。汉初仍用秦制，至《太初历》才改正朔、以正月为岁首。
records.def_en: Re-establishing the year-beginning and the first month when a new dynasty takes power. The early Han kept the Qin system; only the Taichu Calendar corrected it and made the first month the head of the year.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 用北斗斗柄所指的方向给十二个月定位。柄指寅，这个月叫「建寅之月」。「建」即斗柄所指。
records.def_en: Locating the twelve months by the direction the handle of the Big Dipper points to. Pointing at yin, the month is “built on yin”; the word jian means what the handle points at.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 十二个月里，把哪一个定为一年之首。以寅为首叫「建寅」，以子为首叫「建子」。
records.def_en: Which of the twelve months is taken as the head of the year: “built on yin”, “built on zi”, and so on.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 夏、商、周三代岁首制度的合称：夏建寅（正月）、殷建丑（十二月）、周建子（十一月）。秦及汉初用建亥，至《太初历》恢复建寅。
records.def_en: The collective name for the three dynasties’ year-beginnings: Xia on yin, Shang on chou, Zhou on zi. Qin and early Han used hai; the Taichu Calendar restored yin.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 一季三个月的次序称法：孟（头一月）、仲（中间）、季（末一月），如孟春、仲春、季春。
records.def_en: The three months of a season in order: meng (the first), zhong (the middle), ji (the last) — as in early, middle and late spring.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 一年十二个月的排列与名称。历法一改，月序也随岁首而变：建寅即以寅月为正月。
records.def_en: The sequence and the names of the twelve months. Change the calendar and the order shifts with the year-beginning: build on yin, and the yin month is the first.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.term_en: the conjunction at the winter solstice
records.def_zh: 合朔与冬至落在同一天的黎明。古人以此为推算的基准点，也是取上元时所要求的条件之一。
records.def_en: A conjunction falling at dawn on the winter solstice. Taken as a benchmark in reckoning, and one of the conditions sought in fixing the grand epoch.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 为对齐回归年与朔望月的长度差而多出来的那一个月。加在哪个月，历代规则不一。
records.def_en: The extra month added to bring the tropical year and the synodic months into step. Which month it follows has differed across the ages.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 多少年该安插多少个闰月的成规，如十九年七闰。唐《麟德历》废去闰周，改为随实测随时补闰。
records.def_en: The fixed rule for how many intercalary months go into how many years — nineteen years and seven months, for instance. The Linde Calendar abolished the fixed cycle and intercalated as observation required.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 十九年为一章，是置闰的基本周期：一章之内，朔望月与回归年恰好相齐（十九年七闰）。
records.def_en: Nineteen years make one zhang, the basic cycle of intercalation: within it the synodic months and the tropical years come out even.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 阴阳合历置闰的成法：十九个回归年约合二百三十五个朔望月，故十九年中安插七个闰月。
records.def_en: The rule for lunisolar calendars: nineteen tropical years come to about 235 synodic months, so seven intercalary months are inserted in nineteen years.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 上古置闰于岁末时所用的月名：闰月排在十二月之后，就叫十三月。殷墟卜辞里已有此称。
records.def_en: The name for the intercalary month when it was placed at the year’s end — after the twelfth month. The name appears already in the oracle-bone inscriptions.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.term_en: intercalating the month without a mid-term
records.def_zh: 汉《太初历》以后的置闰规则：哪一个月里没有中气，哪一个月就定为闰月。
records.def_en: The rule followed after the Taichu Calendar: whichever month contains no mid-term is the intercalary month.

records.group_zh: 二 · 岁首・月建・置闰
records.group_en: 2 · The year, the months and intercalation
records.def_zh: 决定闰月安插位置与年度的办法总称。历代有岁末置闰、无中气置闰等不同做法。
records.def_en: The general name for deciding when and where to insert an intercalary month — at the year’s end in high antiquity, in the month without a mid-term later on.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 依太阳在黄道上的位置划分的二十四个节点，每约十五度一个。
records.def_en: Twenty-four markers on the sun’s path, roughly fifteen degrees apart.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 二十四节气中排在月首的十二个，是月的分界线。立春、惊蛰一类属「节」。
records.def_en: The twelve terms that fall at the head of a month and mark its boundary: Beginning of Spring, Awakening of Insects and the like.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 二十四节气中排在月中的十二个。雨水、春分一类属「气」。节与气交替，合起来才是二十四节气。
records.def_en: The twelve that fall in mid-month: Rain Water, Spring Equinox and the like. Node and breath alternate; together they make the twenty-four.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 太阳在黄道上走到某一特定度数的那一瞬。它是一个时刻，不是一整天。
records.def_en: The instant the sun reaches a given degree of the ecliptic. An instant, not a whole day.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 太阳在黄道上、从春分点量起的角度。节气就是黄经的整数倍刻度。
records.def_en: The sun’s angle along the ecliptic measured from the vernal equinox. The solar terms are its round-number marks.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 二十四节气里最先被定出的八个：春分、秋分、夏至、冬至，加立春、立夏、立秋、立冬。
records.def_en: The eight terms fixed earliest: the two equinoxes and two solstices, plus the four “beginnings” of spring, summer, autumn and winter.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 把一个回归年等分成二十四份来定节气。不知日行有迟速时的做法，与平朔同时行用。
records.def_en: Fixing the terms by dividing the tropical year into twenty-four equal parts — the method of those who did not know the sun moves unevenly. It went with the mean new moon.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 按太阳在黄道上实际走到某一度数来定节气。清《时宪历》起改用定气注历，沿用至今。
records.def_en: Fixing the terms by the sun’s actual degrees along the ecliptic. The Shixian Calendar introduced it, and it is still in use.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 节气是天上那把尺子走到哪儿了，候是地上你看见什么了。候比气慢着差不多一个月。
records.def_en: The solar term is where the celestial ruler has reached; the phenological period is what you see on the ground. The latter lags by about a month.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 七十二候中每一候所对应的自然现象，如「东风解冻」「桃始华」。有植物、动物、非生物三类。
records.def_en: The natural sign assigned to each of the seventy-two periods — thawing east winds, peach trees in flower. They are drawn from plants, from animals, and from inanimate nature.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 把二十四节气各分三候、每候约五日，共七十二候。完整记载见《逸周书·时训解》。
records.def_en: Each solar term split into three periods of about five days, seventy-two in all. The full record is in the “Shixun jie” chapter of the Yizhou shu.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 二十四节气中惊蛰的旧名。汉时因避景帝刘启之名改写作「惊蛰」，两个字是同一层意思的改写。
records.def_en: The older name of the term now called Awakening of Insects. Under Emperor Jing, whose personal name was Qi, it was rewritten; the two words mean the same thing.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 按月排比天象、物候与政令的体裁。《礼记·月令》是这种体裁的代表，也是节气系统的前身。
records.def_en: The genre that sets out, month by month, the sky, the signs on the ground and the acts of government. The “Yue Ling” of the Book of Rites is its model and the solar terms’ ancestor.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 一年中最热的三段时间，从夏至后第三个庚日起算。它以干支纪日为准，与节气是两套并行的刻度。
records.def_en: The three hottest stretches of the year, counted from the third keng day after the summer solstice. It is reckoned by sexagenary days, a scale parallel to the solar terms.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.def_zh: 从冬至起每九天为一段，历八十一天。是冬季的民间冷暖刻度，也是历书上的常见注记。
records.def_en: Nine-day stretches counted from the winter solstice, eighty-one days in all — a popular scale for the cold and a common note in almanacs.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.term_en: the day of the earth god
records.def_zh: 春秋各一次，以立春、立秋后的第五个戊日为准。与三伏同一算法，都由干支定日。
records.def_en: Twice a year, on the fifth wu day after the beginning of spring and of autumn — reckoned, like the fu, by sexagenary days.

records.group_zh: 三 · 节气・物候
records.term_en: solar terms entered in the almanac
records.def_zh: 把二十四节气逐日注在历书上。汉《太初历》首次完整编入，清《时宪历》起改用定气注历。
records.def_en: Entering the twenty-four terms day by day in the almanac. The Taichu Calendar was the first to carry them in full; the Shixian Calendar began to use the true terms.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十天干与十二地支依次相配、六十组一轮的编号法。「干支」原写作「幹枝」，即树干与枝条，起初并不是一组序数符号。
records.def_en: The cycle formed by pairing the ten stems with the twelve branches, sixty to a round. Originally written 幹枝, “trunk and branches” — not at first ordinal signs at all.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸，共十个。
records.def_en: The ten: jia, yi, bing, ding, wu, ji, geng, xin, ren, gui.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥，共十二个。
records.def_en: The twelve: zi, chou, yin, mao, chen, si, wu, wei, shen, you, xu, hai.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.term_en: the Sixty Binomials of the Sexagenary Cycle
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 干支相配的完整一轮。两条序列本可排出 120 个有序对，只因配对限定在同类之内，才只剩六十。
records.def_en: One full round of the pairing. Two such series admit 120 ordered pairs; pairing is permitted only within a class, so exactly sixty survive.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 用干支给每一天编号。这套编号连续不断，可用来核对历日。
records.def_en: Numbering every day with a binomial of the sexagenary cycle. The count runs unbroken and can be used to check a date.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 用干支给年份编号。东汉元和二年（85 年）才以政令推行全国，此前纪年多用岁星、太岁或年号。
records.def_en: Numbering the years with binomials of the sexagenary cycle. It was ordered for the whole country only in 85 CE; before that years were reckoned by Jupiter, by the counter-Jupiter, or by reign titles.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十干轮完一轮为一旬，即十日。殷墟卜辞已按旬记日，旬末有卜旬之例。
records.def_en: Ten days, the time the ten stems take to complete one round. The oracle bones already count by the ten-day week.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 以皇帝的年号加序号纪年，如「贞观元年」。汉武帝建元为中国年号纪年之始。
records.def_en: Dating by the emperor’s reign title and a number — “the first year of Zhenguan”. Jianyuan, under Emperor Wu of the Han, is the first such title.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 以木星所在的星次纪年，如「岁在星纪」。木星约十二年行一周天，古人称之为岁星。
records.def_en: Reckoning the year by the station the planet Jupiter occupies — “the year star in Xingji”. Jupiter takes about twelve years to circle the sky and was named the “year star”.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 岁星自西向东而行，与十二辰方向相反，古人另设一个反向运行的假想天体「太岁」来纪年，由此有摄提格等十二岁名。
records.def_en: Because Jupiter moves eastward, counter to the order of the twelve stations, a counter-Jupiter was imagined running the other way, giving the twelve year-names such as Shetige.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.def_zh: 沿黄道划分的十二个星区，依次为星纪、玄枵、娵訾等，用于岁星纪年。
records.def_en: Twelve regions along the ecliptic — Xingji, Xuanxiao, Juzi and so on — used for reckoning years by Jupiter.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.def_zh: 沿天球一周按子丑寅卯等十二支划分的区域，方向与十二次相反，用于太岁纪年与分野。
records.def_en: Twelve regions of the sky named by the earthly branches, running opposite to the Jupiter stations; used for counter-Jupiter dating and for field-allocation.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 太岁在寅之年的岁名，为十二岁名之一；其余为单阏、执徐、大荒落、敦牂、协洽、涒滩、作噩、阉茂、大渊献、困敦、赤奋若。
records.def_en: The year-name for a year with the counter-Jupiter in yin. The others are Chanyan, Zhixu, Dahuangluo, Dunzang, Xieqia, Tuntan, Zuo’e, Yanmao, Dayuanxian, Kundun and Chifenruo.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 西汉历家给十干另取的十个名称：阏逢、旃蒙、柔兆、强圉、著雍、屠维、上章、重光、玄黓、昭阳。与十二岁名相配，成六十个年名。
records.def_en: Ten names given to the stems — Yanfeng, Zhanmeng, Rouzhao and so on — paired with the twelve year-names to yield sixty, much as stems pair with branches.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.term_en: the leap of the year station
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 岁星实际约 11.86 年一周天，积久便会超过按十二年一轮所推的位置一次。历家称之为超辰，也是后来改用干支纪年的一个缘由。
records.def_en: Jupiter actually takes about 11.86 years, so in time it outruns the twelve-year reckoning by one station. This “leap” is one reason the sexagenary count displaced it.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 把天上的星次、星宿与地上的州国相配，以星象占其吉凶。配法历代不一，是星占与历法共用的框架。
records.def_en: Matching the stations and mansions of the sky to the provinces and states of the earth, so that a sign above portends below. The matching differs by age; it serves both astrology and calendar.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 把一天分成十二段，每段对应一个地支，各两小时。子时起于二十三时。
records.def_en: Twelve two-hour divisions of the day, one to each branch. The hour of zi begins at 23:00.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 夜里分五更，用于报时。更点与十二时辰是两套并行的夜间刻度。
records.def_en: The night divided into five watches, for calling the hour. Watches and double-hours are two parallel scales for the dark hours.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 更以下的刻度：一夜五更，每更五点。更、点用于报时，历书上记的则是时辰。
records.def_en: A subdivision of the watch: five points to a watch, five watches to a night. Watches and points were for calling the hour; the almanac kept to the double-hours.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 一日分为一百刻，每刻约十四分二十四秒；清康熙九年改用九十六刻，每刻十五分钟，与今制同。
records.def_en: One hundred to the day, each about 14 minutes 24 seconds; changed in 1670 to ninety-six to the day, each fifteen minutes, as now.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 把每个时辰分为「初」「正」两半，十二时辰遂成二十四段，与今日的小时相当。西洋钟表传入后通行。
records.def_en: Splitting each double-hour into an “initial” and a “central” half, turning twelve into twenty-four divisions of about an hour each. It came into general use with Western clocks.

records.group_zh: 四 · 纪日・纪年・时刻
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 以壶盛水、看箭上刻度计时的器具。冬至昼短夜长，刻数随之增减，历代历法都要给出昼夜刻分。
records.def_en: An instrument of water-jars and a graduated float. The number of quarters in day and night shifts with the season, and calendars supplied the figures.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 日月黄经相同、月亮不可见的时刻，即农历每月初一所在的那一天。
records.def_en: The instant the sun and moon share a longitude and the moon is unseen: the day the first of a calendrical month falls on.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 满月的时刻，约在十五。
records.def_en: The instant of the full moon, usually around the fifteenth.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 月亮走到黄经相差九十度与二百七十度时，各见半个月面。
records.def_en: When the moon is ninety and two hundred and seventy degrees from the sun, half its face is lit.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.term_en: the last day of the month
records.def_zh: 每月的最后一日，即下一朔的前一日。晦与朔相接，是月相周期的收尾。
records.def_en: The final day of a calendrical month, the day before the next conjunction — the closing of the phase cycle.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 农历每月初三，月始生明之时。《尚书·召诰》有「三月，惟丙午胐」之记。
records.def_en: The third day of a calendrical month, when the crescent first shows. It appears in the “Zhao Gao” chapter of the Book of Documents.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.term_en: after the birth / after the death of the light
records.def_zh: 西周金文记月相的两个词：「生霸」谓月始明，「死霸」谓月始晦。如何系日，是西周年代学的百年难题。
records.def_en: Two terms for lunar phases in Western Zhou bronze inscriptions: the light begins, and the light ends. How they map onto days remains a century-old problem in Zhou chronology.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 以真实的合朔时刻定初一，而不是用平均值推算。三国时《乾象历》始创此法。
records.def_en: Fixing the first of the month by the actual conjunction rather than by a mean value. First proposed in the Qianxiang Calendar.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 以平均朔望月长度推算的朔。与定朔相对，算法简单但与天不合。
records.def_en: The new moon reckoned from a mean month. Simpler than the true new moon, and less faithful to the sky.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 平朔的又一名称。唐《麟德历》以后，历书多在经朔之上加减改正，才得定朔。
records.def_en: Another name for the mean conjunction. From the Linde Calendar on, the true conjunction was reached by correcting it.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 月亮在恒星背景上的运行。月的行度有迟有疾，历法须逐日列出，称为月离表。
records.def_en: The moon’s movement against the stars. Its speed varies, so the calendars tabulated its daily positions.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 指某时刻距月亮过近地点的时间。月亮过近地点后行速渐减，历法据此校正月行。
records.def_en: The time elapsed since the moon passed perigee. Its speed slackens afterwards, and calendars corrected for it.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 日月运行速度的不均匀。唐以后各历都专设迟疾一术，用以修正平朔、平气。
records.def_en: The unevenness of the sun’s and the moon’s speed. From the Tang on, calendars carried a separate section correcting the mean values.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 日月食的合称。历法能预推交食的时刻与食分，是检验一部历法精粗的硬指标。
records.def_en: Sun and moon eclipses together. Predicting their time and magnitude was the hardest test a calendar could face.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 月亮遮住太阳。只在朔日可能发生，又因白道与黄道有交角，并非每次朔日都有。
records.def_en: The moon covering the sun. Possible only at conjunction, and — the lunar path being inclined to the ecliptic — not at every one.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 地球的影子遮住月亮。只在望日可能发生。
records.def_en: The earth’s shadow covering the moon. Possible only at full moon.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 日月行至黄白两道交点附近。历法先算入交时刻与交分，才判断是否发生交食。
records.def_en: The sun and moon coming near the nodes where the two paths cross. Calendars first reckoned this, then judged whether an eclipse would follow.

records.group_zh: 五 · 朔望・月相・交食
records.def_zh: 交食时被遮去的部分，以分数表示。食分的大小由历法推算，再与所见的相参验。
records.def_en: The fraction of the disc obscured, expressed as a fraction. It was computed and then compared with what was seen.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 太阳一年在恒星之间走过的那条路。节气就刻在这条路上。
records.def_en: The path the sun traces among the stars in a year. The solar terms are marked on it.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 月亮运行的轨道。它与黄道之间有一个约五度的夹角，所以并非每次朔望都有食。
records.def_en: The moon’s orbit. It is inclined about five degrees to the ecliptic, which is why not every new or full moon brings an eclipse.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 把地球赤道面延伸到天球上所得的大圆。与黄道相交于春分、秋分两点。
records.def_en: The great circle obtained by extending the earth’s equator onto the sphere. It meets the ecliptic at the equinoxes.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 黄道与赤道之间的夹角，约二十三度半。战国石申已有测量，后世历法多以它为常数。
records.def_en: The angle between the ecliptic and the equator, about 23.5 degrees. Measured already by Shi Shen, and long carried as a constant.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the three enclosures
records.def_zh: 紫微垣、太微垣、天市垣，中国古代对北天中央一带的三片划分。
records.def_en: Purple Forbidden, Supreme Palace and Heavenly Market: the three divisions of the central northern sky.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 沿黄道赤道一带划分的二十八个星区，用作量天的刻度。宿名现存最早的实物证据之一，是曾侯乙墓出土漆木箱上的题记。
records.def_en: Twenty-eight star regions spread along the ecliptic and equator, used as a scale for the sky. One of the earliest material witnesses to the names is the inscription on a lacquered chest from the tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 每一宿里用来标定该宿位置的标志星。历代所定不尽相同。
records.def_en: The marker star that fixes a mansion’s position. Which star serves has not been constant.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 相邻两宿距星之间的赤经差，即这一宿的宽度。二十八宿宽窄极不均，正因如此才须逐宿记度。
records.def_en: The right-ascension difference between a mansion’s determinative star and the next one — the mansion’s width. The widths are very uneven, which is why each must be recorded.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 天体到北天极的角距离，相当于今日的九十度减赤纬。中国古代用它与入宿度合起来定一颗星的位置。
records.def_en: A body’s angular distance from the north pole — ninety degrees minus the declination. With the mansion entry it fixed a star’s place.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 天体距其西侧第一颗距星的赤经差。中国的赤道坐标以二十八宿距星为起算点，起点不是一个而是二十八个。
records.def_en: A body’s right-ascension difference from the determinative star to its west. The Chinese equatorial system had twenty-eight starting points, not one.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武，与二十八宿分属东、西、南、北四方。
records.def_en: Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird and Dark Warrior — the four quarters to which the mansions are assigned.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 地球自转轴的缓慢进动，使春分点沿黄道缓慢西退。《大明历》首次把它引入历法。
records.def_en: The slow wobble of the earth’s axis, which carries the equinox westward along the ecliptic. The Daming Calendar was the first to allow for it.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 黄昏或拂晓时正南方的星。上古以「昏见」「旦中」的星定季节，是节气之前的季节标尺。
records.def_en: The star due south at dusk or dawn. High antiquity fixed the seasons by which star culminated — the scale that preceded the solar terms.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.term_en: the culminating star at dusk and dawn
records.def_zh: 历书中逐月列出的黄昏、拂晓中星。自《尚书·尧典》的四仲中星起，历代历法都载此项。
records.def_en: The culminating stars for dusk and dawn, given month by month. From the four mid-season stars of the “Yao Dian” onward, calendars carried them.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 太阳在恒星间的位置与行度。历法按节气列出太阳的入宿度与去极度，称为日躔表。
records.def_en: The sun’s place and motion among the stars. Calendars listed its mansion entry and polar distance term by term.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 某星于黄昏初现东方或拂晓初现东方。上古物候与月令多以它为节令标记。
records.def_en: A star’s first appearance at dusk or at dawn. The old monthly ordinances used it to mark the seasons.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 周天分为三百六十五度又四分度之一，与一年的日数相配，故太阳一日恰行一度。这与今日圆周三百六十度不同。
records.def_en: The circle is divided into 365¼ degrees, matching the days of the year, so that the sun moves one degree a day — unlike the modern 360.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 度以下的单位，各历取法不同，或分百、或分千、或分万，与日法一样是各立其数。
records.def_en: The subunits of a degree. Some calendars divided by a hundred, some by a thousand, some by ten thousand — each set its own figure, as with the day divisor.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 过天顶的南北大圆。测影定方向的「正南正北线」即子午线，历法上的一切时刻都以过中天为准。
records.def_en: The great circle through the zenith from north to south. The north-south line laid down in shadow-measurement is the meridian, and all times are taken as a body crosses it.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 观测者所见的地面与天球的交线。日出于地平为旦，没于地平为昏。
records.def_en: Where the observer’s ground meets the sphere. Sunrise above it is dawn, sunset below it dusk.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 位置长期不变的星，与行星相对。二十八宿的距星与三垣的星官都是恒星，古人测天即以它们为背景。
records.def_en: A star whose place holds steady, as against a planet. The determinative stars of the mansions and the officials of the enclosures are all fixed stars, and the sky was measured against them.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 恒星和银河系 · 2024

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 沿黄道一带运行、位置逐月移动的星体。肉眼能见的只有五颗，古人称五星或五纬；「行星」是后起的通名。
records.def_en: A body moving along the ecliptic and shifting its place from month to month. Only five are visible to the naked eye; the word itself is a later general name.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 表示天体明暗的等级，数越小者越亮。中国古代只记星之大小与颜色，此制明末随西学传入，《崇祯历书》的恒星表已用它分等。
records.def_en: A scale of brightness, the smaller number the brighter. Old Chinese catalogues recorded only a star’s size and colour; the scale came in with Western learning in the late Ming.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 从地上看去的亮度分级，未扣除远近的因素。肉眼刚能看见的星，约为六等。
records.def_en: Brightness as seen from the earth, with no allowance for distance. The faintest star the naked eye can catch is about the sixth magnitude.

records.group_zh: 六 · 星空・坐标・测量
records.def_zh: 设想把各星放在同一距离上比较所得的等级。视星等是「看上去多亮」，绝对星等是「本来多亮」。
records.def_en: The magnitude a star would show if all were set at one distance. Apparent magnitude is how bright it looks; absolute, how bright it is.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 由若干同心圆环组成的测天仪器，用来量天体的入宿度与去极度。
records.def_en: An instrument of concentric rings for measuring a body’s position among the mansions and its distance from the pole.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 演示天球运转的仪器，球面上刻着星宿。浑仪是量天的，浑象是演天的。
records.def_en: An instrument showing the turning sphere, with the mansions marked on it. The armillary measures the sky; the globe demonstrates it.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 立表测影的器具，用来定冬至与回归年长度。影最长的那一天是冬至。
records.def_en: A post and a graduated scale for measuring the noon shadow, used to fix the winter solstice and the length of the year.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 表所投下的日影长度。冬至影最长、夏至影最短，由影长定二至，是定回归年的基础。
records.def_en: The length of the shadow cast by the gnomon. Longest at the winter solstice, shortest at the summer: it fixed the solstices and so the length of the year.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 以晷针的影子在盘面上的方位指示时刻的器具。圭表算影的长短以定节气，日晷算影的方位以定时刻。
records.def_en: An instrument whose pointer’s shadow shows the hour by its direction on a dial. The gnomon measures the shadow’s length for the seasons; the sundial measures its bearing for the hour.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 中国古代对星的划分单位：若干相邻的星编为一官，各给名称。与西洋星座相似而分法不同。
records.def_en: The Chinese unit of star grouping: a few neighbours are formed into one “official” and given a name. Like a constellation, but divided differently.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.term_en: the central palace / the five palaces
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 天区的划分法之一。《史记·天官书》分全天为中、东、南、西、北五宫，以中官为北极一带。
records.def_en: One way of dividing the sky. The “Treatise on the Celestial Offices” makes five palaces — centre, east, south, west, north — the central one about the pole.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.term_en: the three enclosures and the twenty-eight mansions
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the three enclosures
records.def_zh: 隋唐以后通行的全天划分体制：三垣统北天中央，二十八宿环布四周，全部星官都收得进去。
records.def_en: The scheme current from the Sui-Tang: the three enclosures about the north centre and the twenty-eight mansions around them take in every official.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 三国吴太史令陈卓合石氏、甘氏、巫咸三家星官，定为二百八十三官、一千四百六十四星，后世星图星表均以此为准。
records.def_en: The Grand Astrologer of Wu combined the star-lists of the three schools into 283 officials and 1,464 stars. Later charts and catalogues follow him.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 把星官按位置绘出的图。敦煌卷子中的唐代星图与苏州石刻天文图，是现存最重要的两件。
records.def_en: A chart plotting the officials by position. The Tang chart in a Dunhuang manuscript and the Suzhou stone chart are the chief survivors.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 《吕氏春秋·有始览》把天分为中央与八方共九野，各配若干星宿，是二十八宿之外的一种天区划分。
records.def_en: The “You Shi Lan” of the Lüshi Chunqiu divides the sky into nine fields, centre and eight directions, each with its mansions — a division beside the twenty-eight.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 二十八宿与七曜、动物相配而成的一套名目，多用于术数。它由星宿体系派生，与历法推算无关。
records.def_en: Names pairing the mansions with the seven luminaries and with animals, chiefly used in the mantic arts. A derivative of the mansion system, not part of calendrical reckoning.

records.group_zh: 七 · 仪器・星官・星图
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 中国古代的天文台。周代把观测天象、奉神占星的场所称为灵台；汉代有灵台，属太史。
records.def_en: The astronomical observatory of ancient China. The Zhou called the place for watching the sky and for observing the stars in service of the spirits the numinous terrace; the Han kept one under the Grand Astrologer.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 废止旧历、颁行新历。中国历代改历约百次，原因或为误差累积，或为改朝换代更定正朔。
records.def_en: Scrapping a calendar and promulgating a new one. Chinese history saw some hundred reforms, driven either by accumulated error or by a new dynasty’s claim to set the calendar.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 每年由朝廷造历、颁行天下。历书官造官颁，私造历书历来在禁。
records.def_en: The court’s annual making and issuing of the almanac. It was a government monopoly, and private almanacs were forbidden.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 非官颁的历书。历代多立禁条，然民间的通书、黄历仍辗转流传。
records.def_en: An almanac not issued by the state. Repeatedly banned, yet popular almanacs went on circulating.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 禁止私造、私售历书的法令。唐、宋、明、清的律中皆有相应条文。
records.def_en: The law forbidding the private making and selling of almanacs, set down in the codes of Tang, Song, Ming and Qing.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.tag_zh: 历法术语 · 历代历法
records.def_zh: 现行阴阳合历的通行叫法。它实为《时宪历》一系，因用夏正、服务于农时，后世通称农历——「农历」之名其实出现很晚。
records.def_en: The common name of the lunisolar calendar in use, a descendant of the Shixian Calendar. Called “agricultural” only in recent centuries, from its use of the Xia first month and its service to farming.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 民间日用的历书，逐日载宜忌、吉凶、神煞。由官历派生，明清流布极广。
records.def_en: The household almanac, giving day by day the prescriptions, the prohibitions and the spirits. Derived from the official calendar, it spread widely from the Ming-Qing on.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.tag_zh: 历法术语 · 历代历法
records.def_zh: 清代官颁历书的名目，自《时宪历》而来。辛亥革命后仍行，至民国改行公历为止。
records.def_en: The name of the Qing official almanac, from the Shixian Calendar. It continued after 1911, until the Republic adopted the Gregorian calendar.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.term_en: the calendrical chapters of the standard histories
records.def_zh: 历代正史中记历法的专篇，是研究古历的第一手材料。名目不一，或名律历志、历志、历象志、时宪志。
records.def_en: The calendrical chapters of the standard histories, the primary source for the old calendars. They are titled variously — pitches and calendar, calendar, calendar and astronomy, or calendrical ordinances.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 秦汉以来掌天时星历的官，属太常，岁终奏新年历。后世名目与隶属屡变：唐宋有太史局、司天监，明清归钦天监。
records.def_en: The office charged with the seasons and the calendar from Qin and Han times, under the Court of Ceremonial. Its name and its bureau changed repeatedly: the Astrological Bureau and the Observatory under Tang and Song, the Imperial Observatory under Ming and Qing.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 唐宋金元掌天文、历法与占候的官署。唐称司天台，宋、金、元称司天监；明初一度沿置，洪武三年改称钦天监。
records.def_en: The bureau for astronomy, the calendar and omens under Tang, Song, Jin and Yuan — the Astrological Terrace first, the Observatory after. Kept for a few years under the Ming, then renamed.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 明清两代掌观象、造历、颁历的官署。明洪武三年由司天监改设，清沿置，设监正、监副。
records.def_en: The bureau of the Ming and Qing for observing, making and issuing the calendar. Set up in 1370 in place of the earlier observatory, and kept by the Qing with a director and deputies.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.def_zh: 指世代相传、专司历算的人。语出《史记·历书》「畴人子弟分散」。
records.def_en: One who keeps calendrical reckoning in the family. The word stands in the “Treatise on the Calendar” of the Records of the Grand Historian.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.term_en: the Office of the Starry Signs
records.def_zh: 《周礼·春官》所载之官，掌天星，记日月星辰的变动。是文献里最早的天文之官之一。
records.def_en: An office in the “Spring Offices” of the Rites of Zhou, charged with the stars and the changes of sun, moon and planets — one of the earliest astronomical posts on record.

records.group_zh: 八 · 历法沿革・行用
records.term_en: the Office of the Heavenly Order
records.def_zh: 《周礼·春官》所载之官，掌十二岁、十二月、十二辰一类天文次序。
records.def_en: Another office in the same chapter, charged with the twelve years, the twelve months and the twelve stations — the order of the heavens.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 岁星、荧惑、镇星、太白、辰星五颗行星的合称，古又称五纬。五星各有行度，历代历法多设专篇，推其入宿度与去极度。
records.def_en: The collective name for the five planets — Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, Venus, Mercury — also called the five wefts. Calendars carried a section reckoning their places among the mansions.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 古人对木星的称呼。约十二年行一周天，一年走一个星次，因而用来纪年。
records.def_en: The old name for Jupiter. It circles the sky in about twelve years, one station a year, and was therefore used to reckon years.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 古人对火星的称呼。荧荧似火，而行度在五星中最不定，顺逆疾徐无常，故名。
records.def_en: The old name for Mars. Faintly fiery, and the least regular of the five in its motion — direct or retrograde, fast or slow without a rule.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 古人对金星的称呼。五星之中其光最盛：晨见于东方叫启明，昏见于西方叫长庚。
records.def_en: The old name for Venus, the brightest of the five. Seen at dawn in the east it was Qiming; at dusk in the west, Changgeng.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 古人对水星的称呼。距日最近，一年中多半隐在日光里，可见的时候不多。
records.def_en: The old name for Mercury. It keeps nearest the sun and is lost in the daylight for most of the year.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 古人对土星的称呼。约二十八年行一周天，一年镇守一个星宿，故名。
records.def_en: The old name for Saturn. It takes about twenty-eight years to circle the sky and sits over one mansion a year, whence the name.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 行星与太阳黄经相同，叫合日；两颗行星黄经相同，也叫合。与日相合则伏而不见。
records.def_en: A planet standing at the same longitude as the sun, or two planets at the same longitude. At conjunction with the sun a planet is lost in its light.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 行星与太阳黄经相差一百八十度。日在西而星在东，日落时星自东方升起，终夜可见。外行星才有此象。
records.def_en: A planet standing opposite the sun. It rises in the east as the sun sets and stays up all night; only the outer planets can come to it.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 行星由顺行转逆行、或由逆行转顺行时，在天球上暂时停留不动的现象。
records.def_en: The point at which a planet, turning from direct to retrograde motion or back, seems for a while to stand still among the stars.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 行星自东向西的视运动。自西向东叫顺行，回头向西叫逆行，二者交替，周而复始。
records.def_en: A planet’s apparent motion from east to west. Direct motion eastward, retrograde westward; the two alternate in turn.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 行星行至与日相近，隐于日光中不见，谓之伏。伏后复见，叫「见」。
records.def_en: A planet drawing near the sun and vanishing into its light. Its reappearance is the heliacal rising.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 五星或月行至某星近旁、侵入其界内，史志称「犯」。正史天文志里这类记事最多。
records.def_en: A planet or the moon coming so near a star as to encroach on it — among the commonest entries in the astronomical chapters of the histories.

records.group_zh: 九 · 五星・行星天象
records.group_en: 9 · The five planets and planetary phenomena
records.def_zh: 五星行至某星官之内，久留不去，史志称「守」。与「犯」同为记五星行度的常用语。
records.def_en: A planet lingering long within one group of stars. With encroachment, the usual way the histories record a planet’s course.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the three enclosures
records.def_zh: 「三垣」的中垣，位于北天中央，包括北天极附近的天区。《步天歌》里它名下的星官最多。
records.def_en: The middle of the three enclosures, about the north celestial pole — the central division of the northern sky, and the one carrying the most asterisms in the Song of Pacing the Heavens.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the three enclosures
records.def_zh: 「三垣」的上垣，在紫微垣与张宿、翼宿之间。
records.def_en: The upper of the three enclosures, lying between the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and the mansions Zhang and Yi.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the three enclosures
records.def_zh: 「三垣」的下垣，在紫微垣与心宿、尾宿之间。
records.def_en: The lower of the three enclosures, lying between the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and the mansions Xin and Wei.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 大熊座中七颗较亮的星，即「北斗七星」；古人用它定方向、定季节。
records.def_en: Seven bright stars of Ursa Major, that is, the seven stars of the Northern Dipper; in China they served to fix direction and to mark the seasons.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.term_en: the seven stars of the Big Dipper
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · star officials
records.def_zh: 「北斗」七星的名称，自斗口至斗柄依次为天枢、天璇、天玑、天权、玉衡、开阳、摇光；前四星合称斗魁（又称璇玑），后三星合称斗杓（又称斗柄、玉衡）。依拜耳命名依次为大熊座 α、β、γ、δ、ε、ζ、η；天枢、天璇连线延长五倍指向北极星，故又称指极星。宗教与术数文献里另有一套称谓：贪狼、巨门、禄存、文曲、廉贞、武曲、破军。与「北斗」条同指。
records.def_en: The names of the seven stars of the Northern Dipper, from bowl to handle: Tianshu, Tianxuan, Tianji, Tianquan, Yuheng, Kaiyang and Yaoguang — the first four forming the Bowl and the last three the Handle. They are designated α, β, γ, δ, ε, ζ and η Ursae Majoris; Tianshu and Tianxuan, whose line extended five times points to the pole star, are the Pointers. Religious and divinatory writings give them a further set of names: Tanlang, Jumen, Lucun, Wenqu, Lianzhen, Wuqu and Pojun. Same referent as the entry ‘the Big Dipper’.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.def_zh: 小熊座 α，是当前全天最靠近北天极的星。它与北天极的角距在公元 2100 年前后最小，约 28 角分。
records.def_en: Alpha Ursae Minoris, at present the star nearest the north celestial pole. Its distance from the pole is least — about 28 minutes of arc — around 2100 CE.

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.def_zh: 过天球中心、与地球自转轴平行的直线与天球相交的两点，即北天极与南天极。它不是一个星，是一个点。
records.def_en: The two points where the line through the sphere’s centre parallel to the earth’s axis meets the sphere. Not a star, but a point.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十 · 三垣・拱极星区
records.group_en: 10 · The three enclosures and the circumpolar sky
records.def_zh: 赤纬绝对值大于八十度的恒星，即绕天极转而不落的那一圈星。文献里有时也泛指低纬度可见其下中天的星。
records.def_en: A star whose declination exceeds eighty degrees in absolute value — one that circles the pole without setting. Also used loosely of stars seen to lower-culminate at low latitudes.

records.group_zh: 十一 · 四象・二十八宿
records.group_en: 11 · The four images and the twenty-eight mansions
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 四象之一，由角、亢、氐、房、心、尾、箕七宿组成。五行配五方，东方为青，故名。也写作「青龙」。
records.def_en: One of the four images, formed of the seven mansions Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei and Ji. East takes the colour azure in the five-phase scheme, whence the name; also written Qinglong.

records.group_zh: 十一 · 四象・二十八宿
records.group_en: 11 · The four images and the twenty-eight mansions
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 二十八宿的第一宿，属东方苍龙。距星为角宿一（室女座 α）。《步天歌》载此宿有星官十一、星四十五。
records.def_en: The first of the twenty-eight mansions, in the Azure Dragon of the East. Its determinative star is Alpha Virginis. The Song of Pacing the Heavens gives it eleven asterisms and forty-five stars.

records.group_zh: 十一 · 四象・二十八宿
records.group_en: 11 · The four images and the twenty-eight mansions
records.tag_zh: 星宿与星官 · 二十八宿
records.tag_en: Mansions and star officials · the twenty-eight mansions
records.def_zh: 二十八宿的第二宿，属东方苍龙。距星为亢宿一（室女座 κ）。《步天歌》载此宿有星官七、星二十二。
records.def_en: The second of the twenty-eight mansions, in the Azure Dragon of the East. Its determinative star is Kappa Virginis. The Song of Pacing the Heavens gives it seven asterisms and twenty-two stars.

records.group_zh: 十一 · 四象・二十八宿
records.group_en: 11 · The four images and the twenty-eight mansions

records.def_en: The eighteenth of the twenty-eight mansions, in the White Tiger of the West. Its determinative star is 17 Tauri. The mansion is the star cluster that Western astronomy calls the Pleiades; six or seven stars are visible to the naked eye. The English name follows Termonline, whose entry for this mansion (Cross-Strait Astronomical Terms, 2013) reads “Pliades”; its entry for the cluster (Astronomical Terms, 2024) reads “Pleiades”, the common spelling. The Song of Pacing the Heavens gives it nine asterisms and forty-seven stars.

records.def_zh: 始于战国的一种以地为中心的有限宇宙体系之说：天浑圆如弹丸，日月星辰附在天球上运行，地悬在空中、浮于气内，像蛋黄裹在蛋壳里。
records.def_en: A finite, earth-centred cosmology from the Warring States: the heavens are round as a pellet, sun, moon and stars ride on the sphere, and the earth hangs within, floating in air like a yolk in its shell.

records.def_zh: 中国最早的宇宙结构之说：天像一口盖着的碗或一顶斗笠，地像一个倒扣的盘子，天在地之上、日月星辰随天而转。
records.def_en: The oldest Chinese cosmography: the sky is a bowl or a conical hat above a tilted dish of earth, and the sun, moon and stars turn with the sky above it.

records.term_en: the theory of an infinite universe
records.def_zh: 主张天没有形质、没有边界，日月众星各自浮在虚空之中、凭气而动。与浑天、盖天同为古代三家宇宙之说。
records.def_en: Holds that the heavens have neither body nor boundary, and that sun, moon and stars float separately in empty space, moved by their own breath. With the sphere-heavens and the heavenly-cover it is one of the three old cosmologies.

records.def_zh: 为确定天体的位置和运动，设想把地球包在里面、与地球同心的一层假想圆球。天极、赤道、黄道都是这层球面上的圈与点。
records.def_en: An imaginary sphere concentric with the earth, on which the positions and motions of bodies are reckoned. The celestial pole, the equator and the ecliptic are its points and circles.

records.def_en: Alpha Scorpii, the second star of the mansion Xin, and the fire of the old line in the Book of Songs about the fire declining in the seventh month. One of the most important stars for telling the seasons in high antiquity.

records.def_zh: 晴天夜里可见的一条横过星空的乳白色亮带，古人以为它是天上的一条河，因而又叫天河。
records.def_en: The pale band of light across a clear night sky; the old Chinese took it for a river in the heavens, and so called it the celestial river.

records.group_zh: 十二 · 星名・星表・天河・宇宙论
records.group_en: 12 · Star names, catalogues, the Milky Way and cosmology
records.def_zh: 以七言歌诀分述三垣二十八宿全部星官的歌辞，相传为隋丹元子所作。后世认星、绘星图多以它为纲，也是星官数统计的主要依据之一。
records.def_en: Seven-character verses setting out every star official under the three enclosures and the twenty-eight mansions, traditionally ascribed to Dan Yuanzi of the Sui. Later star-lore and charting took it as their frame, and it is one of the chief sources for counting the officials.

records.group_zh: 十二 · 星名・星表・天河・宇宙论
records.group_en: 12 · Star names, catalogues, the Milky Way and cosmology
records.term_en: the Star Classic of Master Shi
records.def_zh: 战国魏人石申所著星表，原书已佚，其内容因《开元占经》的引用而部分留存，含二十八宿距星与一百二十余颗恒星的赤道坐标。
records.def_en: The star catalogue of Shi Shen of Wei. The original is lost; what survives is preserved through quotation in the Kaiyuan Zhanjing, including the determinative stars of the mansions and the equatorial coordinates of more than a hundred and twenty fixed stars.

records.group_zh: 十二 · 星名・星表・天河・宇宙论
records.group_en: 12 · Star names, catalogues, the Milky Way and cosmology
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 明清两代观测天象的台址，北京古观象台即其一。台上置浑仪、简仪、天体仪等，与钦天监的造历相表里。
records.def_en: The observing platform of the Ming and Qing, of which the old one at Beijing still stands. Armillary spheres, abridged instruments and a celestial globe stood upon it, in service of the Imperial Observatory’s calendars.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 「朔」的今名：日月黄经相同、月面不可见的时刻，今称新月。见「朔」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for shuo: the moment when sun and moon share the same celestial longitude and the moon’s face is turned from us. See Shuo.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 朔后初见于西方天空的月牙，状如蛾眉，日落后可见。
records.def_en: The crescent first caught in the western sky after new moon, shaped like an eyebrow, visible after sunset.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 「上弦」的今名：月亮位于太阳以东九十度，日落时正当中天，西半边明亮。见「上弦／下弦」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for the first quarter: the moon stands ninety degrees east of the sun, culminates at sunset, and its western half is lit.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 上弦到望之间的月相，被照亮的部分大于半个，逐夜变圆。
records.def_en: The phase between first quarter and full moon, when more than half the disc is lit and it grows rounder night by night.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 「望」的今名：月亮与太阳黄经相差一百八十度，日落时东升、日出时西落。见「望」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for wang: sun and moon stand 180 degrees apart in longitude, the moon rising at sunset and setting at sunrise. See Wang.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 望到下弦之间的月相，被照亮的部分大于半个，逐夜变缺。
records.def_en: The phase between full moon and last quarter, when more than half the disc is lit and it wanes night by night.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 「下弦」的今名：月亮位于太阳以西九十度，日出时正当中天，东半边明亮。见「上弦／下弦」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for the last quarter: the moon stands ninety degrees west of the sun, culminates at sunrise, and its eastern half is lit.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 下弦之后到朔之前的月牙，黎明前见于东方。
records.def_en: The crescent between last quarter and new moon, caught in the east before dawn.

records.group_zh: 十三 · 月相（今名）
records.def_zh: 自朔起算的日数，朔日为零。本站历日页「月相月龄」即指此。
records.def_en: The number of days elapsed since new moon, counted from zero on the day of shuo; the almanac page here gives it alongside the phase.

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 「岁实」的今名：太阳连续两次过春分点所历的时间，约 365.2422 日。见「岁实」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for the tropical year; see Sui-shi. About 365.2422 days.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 「岁周」的今名：太阳连续两次回到同一颗恒星所历的时间，约 365.2564 日，比回归年略长。见「岁周」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for the sidereal year; see Sui-zhou. About 365.2564 days, a little longer than the tropical year.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 地球连续两次过近日点所历的时间，约 365.2596 日。
records.def_en: The time the earth takes to return twice to perihelion, about 365.2596 days.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 「朔策」的今名：月相圆缺一轮所历的时间，约 29.5306 日。见「朔策」条。
records.def_en: The modern name for the synodic month; see Shuo-ce. One full round of the phases, about 29.5306 days.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 月球连续两次回到同一颗恒星所历的时间，约 27.3217 日，比朔望月短。
records.def_en: The time the moon takes to return to the same star, about 27.3217 days — shorter than the synodic month.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 月球连续两次过近地点所历的时间，约 27.5546 日。月行迟疾的周期即以此为准，见「入转」条。
records.def_en: The time the moon takes to return twice to perigee, about 27.5546 days; it sets the cycle of the moon’s changing speed. See Ru-zhuan.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 月球连续两次过同一黄白交点所历的时间，约 27.2122 日。交食是否发生，要看它落在何处。
records.def_en: The time the moon takes to return to the same node of its path against the ecliptic, about 27.2122 days; whether an eclipse occurs turns on where this falls.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 太阳连续两次过同一子午线所历的时间，平太阳日定为二十四小时。
records.def_en: The interval between two successive passages of the sun across the same meridian; the mean solar day is fixed at twenty-four hours.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 恒星连续两次过同一子午线所历的时间，平恒星日约二十三时五十六分四秒，比太阳日短约四分钟。
records.def_en: The interval between two successive passages of a star across the same meridian; about 23 h 56 m 4 s, some four minutes shorter than the solar day.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 以真太阳的时角计的时间，日晷所指示的就是它。它走得不均匀。
records.def_en: Time reckoned by the hour angle of the true sun — what a sundial reads. It does not run evenly.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 以假想的匀行太阳计的时间，钟表所走的即是这一种。它与真太阳时之差称均时差。
records.def_en: Time reckoned by a fictitious sun moving at a uniform rate; this is what clocks keep. Its difference from apparent solar time is the equation of time.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 东经一百二十度的平太阳时，即东八区区时，不是北京当地的太阳时。
records.def_en: The mean solar time of the 120th meridian east — the standard time of the eighth zone, and not the local solar time of Beijing.

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 本初子午线（格林尼治）的平太阳时，是星历与天文年表常用的时间尺度。
records.def_en: The mean solar time of the prime meridian at Greenwich, a time scale much used in ephemerides and almanacs.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 以春分点的时角计的时间，一个恒星日约为二十三时五十六分四秒。
records.def_en: Time reckoned by the hour angle of the vernal equinox; a sidereal day is about 23 h 56 m 4 s.

records.group_zh: 十四 · 年月周期与时制（今用）
records.group_en: 14 · Periods of year and month, and time systems (modern)
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 真太阳时与平太阳时之差，一年之中在正负十六分之间往复，是换算出生时辰时必须考虑的一项。
records.def_en: The difference between apparent and mean solar time, running within some sixteen minutes either way over the year — a term that must be allowed for when converting a recorded hour of birth.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，子时，今二十三时至一时，一夜的中点。又名子夜、子半。
records.def_en: One of the twelve double-hour names: the zi hour, 23:00 to 01:00, the middle of the night.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，丑时，今一时至三时。
records.def_en: The chou hour, 01:00 to 03:00 — the hour of cock-crow.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，寅时，今三时至五时，是夜与日交替之际。
records.def_en: The yin hour, 03:00 to 05:00, where night gives way to day.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，卯时，今五时至七时。也指太阳升出地平线的时刻。
records.def_en: The mao hour, 05:00 to 07:00; also the moment the sun rises above the horizon.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，辰时，今七时至九时，古人吃早饭的时候。与交食所说的时长不是一回事。
records.def_en: The chen hour, 07:00 to 09:00 — the morning meal in old China. Not to be confused with the duration of an eclipse.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，巳时，今九时至十一时，临近中午。
records.def_en: The si hour, 09:00 to 11:00, drawing near noon.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，午时，今十一时至十三时，太阳过中天之时。也指昼夜均分的春分与秋分，《尚书·尧典》「日中星鸟」即用后一义。
records.def_en: The wu hour, 11:00 to 13:00, when the sun culminates. Also used of the equinoxes, as in the Canon of Yao’s “mid-day star, Bird”.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，未时，今十三时至十五时，日头开始偏西。
records.def_en: The wei hour, 13:00 to 15:00, when the sun begins to slant westward.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，申时，今十五时至十七时，古人吃第二顿饭的时候，又名夕食。
records.def_en: The shen hour, 15:00 to 17:00, the second meal of the day.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，酉时，今十七时至十九时。也指太阳没入地平线的时刻，与「日出」相对。
records.def_en: The you hour, 17:00 to 19:00; also the moment the sun sinks below the horizon, the counterpart of sunrise.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，戌时，今十九时至二十一时。
records.def_en: The xu hour, 19:00 to 21:00.

records.group_zh: 十五 · 十二时称
records.tag_zh: 天文基础 · 时间系统
records.def_zh: 十二时称之一，亥时，今二十一时至二十三时，夜已深而人将息。十二时称至此而一周。
records.def_en: The hai hour, 21:00 to 23:00, when the night is deep and people settle. It closes the round of the twelve.

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 地球赤道面延伸到天球上所截的大圆，即「赤道」在天文上的本义；冠一「天」字，用以区别于地球赤道。见「赤道」条。
records.def_en: The great circle cut on the sphere by the plane of the earth’s equator — what “equator” means in astronomy; the word “celestial” sets it apart from the earth’s own equator.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 自春分点起沿天赤道向东量至天体所在时圈的角距。它与赤纬合起来定一颗星的位置；中国古代不用它，而用入宿度。
records.def_en: Angular distance measured eastward along the celestial equator from the vernal equinox to a body’s hour circle. With declination it fixes a star’s place; traditional Chinese astronomy used mansion entry instead.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 天体沿时圈量至天赤道的角距，在天赤道以北者为正。中国古代与之相当的是去极度。
records.def_en: A body’s angular distance from the celestial equator measured along its hour circle, positive north of it. Its Chinese counterpart is polar distance.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 天体沿黄经圈量至黄道的角距。它与黄经合起来，就是黄道坐标。
records.def_en: A body’s angular distance from the ecliptic measured along a circle of latitude. With celestial longitude it makes up the ecliptic coordinates.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 黄道的两个极点，即过天球中心垂直于黄道面的直线与天球相交的两点，距天极约二十三度半。
records.def_en: Either pole of the ecliptic — where the line through the sphere’s centre perpendicular to the ecliptic meets it, some 23½ degrees from the celestial pole.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 天赤道的两个极点，也就是地球自转轴与天球相交的两点，与「天极」同指。
records.def_en: Either pole of the celestial equator — where the earth’s axis meets the sphere, the same two points as the celestial poles.

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 天体过观测者子午圈的时刻或位置。过天顶那一侧的称上中天，过另一侧的称下中天。
records.def_en: The moment or place at which a body crosses the observer’s meridian: upper culmination on the zenith side, lower culmination on the other.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 观测者头顶正上方、铅垂线向上与天球相交的一点，其地平高度为九十度。
records.def_en: The point of the sphere directly overhead, where the vertical upward meets it; its altitude is ninety degrees.
records.termonline_subject_zh: 天文学 · 天体测量学 · 2024

records.group_zh: 十六 · 坐标与中天（今用）
records.def_zh: 天体沿地平经圈量至地平的角距，又名地平纬度。它与方位角合起来，就是地平坐标。
records.def_en: A body’s angular distance above the horizon measured along a vertical circle, also called its altitude. With azimuth it makes up the horizontal coordinates.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 拖着长尾、沿扁长轨道运行的天体，古称扫帚星。马王堆汉墓出土帛书上的彗星图，是现存最早的彗星形态图。
records.def_en: A body on a long, flattened path and trailing a tail; known in old Chinese as the broom star. The comet chart on the Mawangdui silk manuscript is the earliest surviving chart of comet forms.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 古代天文志中与彗星并列的一类天体，以其光芒四出而得名。历代多与彗星同记。
records.def_en: A class of body recorded in the dynastic treatises on astronomy alongside comets, named for the rays that shoot out from it; the two are usually entered together.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 突然出现于星官之间、历时不久又隐没的星。史书所记至和元年（1054 年）天关客星，今多认为是一次超新星爆发的记录。
records.def_en: A star that appears suddenly among the asterisms and fades again. The guest star of 1054 at Tian-guan, as the histories record it, is now widely taken to be an account of a supernova.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 夜里划过天空、瞬息即灭的亮线，是尘粒进入大气后燃烧的痕迹。成批出现的称流星雨。
records.def_en: A brief streak across the night sky, the trace of dust burning up as it enters the atmosphere; in numbers it becomes a meteor shower.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 落到地面的流星体残块。历代史书多记为「星陨如雨」或「陨石于某地」。
records.def_en: A fragment of a meteoroid that reaches the ground. The histories record such falls as stars raining down, or a stone falling at such-and-such a place.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 从太阳边缘喷出的火焰状气体，日全食时肉眼可见。甲骨卜辞里的「三焰」曾被释为日珥，此事学界尚有争论。
records.def_en: Flamelike gas thrown out beyond the sun’s limb, visible to the naked eye in a total eclipse. The “three flames” of one oracle-bone record were once read as a prominence, a reading still disputed.

records.group_zh: 十七 · 特殊天象
records.def_zh: 太阳光球上的暗斑。中国古代观测记录甚多，《汉书·五行志》河平元年（前 28 年）一条尤常被称引。
records.def_en: A dark patch on the sun’s photosphere. Chinese records of it are numerous; the entry in the Han History’s Treatise on the Five Phases for 28 BCE is among the most often cited.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 元郭守敬创制的测天仪器。它把浑仪拆成赤道装置与地平装置两组，免去多环交叠、遮住视线的毛病。
records.def_en: An instrument built by Guo Shoujing under the Yuan. It split the armillary sphere into separate equatorial and horizontal mounts, so that overlapping rings no longer blocked the view.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 元郭守敬创制的仪器。铜制半球仰置，内壁刻坐标，借中心针影读取太阳的位置与时刻。
records.def_en: A Yuan instrument of Guo Shoujing’s: a bronze hemisphere set bowl upward and graduated within, from whose central needle’s shadow the sun’s place and the hour are read.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 北宋元祐年间苏颂、韩公廉等造成，以水力驱动，把浑仪、浑象与报时装置合于一台。《新仪象法要》即为此台而作。
records.def_en: Built in the 1090s by Su Song and Han Gonglian and driven by water, it combined an armillary sphere, a celestial globe and a time-announcing mechanism in one tower; the New Design for an Armillary Clock was written for it.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 以壶盛水、水渐下漏、看箭上刻度计时的器具。一昼夜分一百刻，即由它量出。
records.def_en: A vessel from which water drips at a steady rate, the time read off a graduated rod; the hundred quarters of the day were measured with it.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 《周礼·考工记》所记的测影之器，以日影的长短定日至、以影的方位定方向。
records.def_en: The shadow-measuring device described in the Artificers’ Record of the Rites of Zhou, which fixed the solstices by the length of the sun’s shadow and the cardinal directions by its bearing.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.term_en: the graduated rule of the gnomon
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 圭表上量取影长的刻度尺。山西襄汾陶寺遗址一座大墓出土带刻度的漆杆，研究者多认为是圭尺一类。
records.def_en: The graduated rule along which the shadow’s length is read on a gnomon table. A painted rod with graduations from a large tomb at Taosi in Shanxi is widely taken to be of this kind.

records.group_zh: 十八 · 仪象器用（补）
records.tag_zh: 律历制度 · 观测方法
records.def_zh: 立表测影，以影长与影的方位定日至、定方向、定时刻，是中国古代最基本的天文测量手段。《周礼·考工记》记有以圆规取日出、日入影端之法。
records.def_en: Setting up a gnomon and measuring its shadow to fix the solstices, the cardinal directions and the hours — the most basic observational method of early Chinese astronomy. The Rites of Zhou describes drawing a circle to catch the shadow’s tip at sunrise and sunset.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历书系于每日之下的十二个名目：建、除、满、平、定、执、破、危、成、收、开、闭。以月建之日为「建」，逐日顺行十二辰。其体例见《协纪辨方书》卷四。
records.def_en: Twelve labels written under the day in the old almanacs — jian, chu, man, ping, ding, zhi, po, wei, cheng, shou, kai and bi — beginning with jian on the day of the month-builder and running through the twelve branches. The scheme is set out in juan 4 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.term_en: the twelve deities of the yellow and black paths
records.def_zh: 旧历注以日支定「青龙」所临之辰，逐辰顺行，得十二神：青龙、明堂、天刑、朱雀、金匮、天德、白虎、玉堂、天牢、玄武、司命、勾陈。前六称黄道，后六称黑道。见《协纪辨方书》。
records.def_en: Twelve deities assigned to the hours by reckoning from the day branch: Qinglong, Mingtang, Tianxing, Zhuque, Jinkui, Tiande, Baihu, Yutang, Tianlao, Xuanwu, Siming and Gouchen — the first six of the yellow path, the last six of the black. See the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历注中的六个名目：先胜、友引、先负、佛灭、大安、赤口。以农历月、日相加取六而起。源出古代历注。
records.def_en: Six labels of the old calendrical annotations — shosho, tomoiki, senbu, butsumetsu, taian and shakko — obtained by adding the calendrical month and day. They derive from old calendrical annotation.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历书于日下标注的两项：一为日支与所用之年支、月支相冲（子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥，共六冲）；一为按三合局所定的煞方（申子辰煞南、寅午戌煞北、巳酉丑煞东、亥卯未煞西）。与行星的「冲」不是一回事。
records.def_en: Two items marked under the day in the old almanacs: the clash of the day branch with the year or month branch in use (the six clashes), and the inauspicious direction fixed by the three-harmony groups. Not the same as the opposition of a planet.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历书于每日之下分列「宜」「忌」两栏事项的体例，所据为建除、宿直等旧说。见《协纪辨方书》卷三十一月表体例。
records.def_en: The old almanac’s practice of listing under each day two columns of activities, one recommended and one to be avoided, on the basis of the day-officers and the mansion of the day. See the monthly tables in juan 31 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历书附注于日下的一类名目，如天赦、月德、天德、四离、四绝、月破、岁破等，各按年月日的干支配合而起。名目与起例散见《协纪辨方书》卷三、卷五。
records.def_en: A class of labels attached to individual days in the old almanacs — Heavenly Pardon, Lunar Virtue, Heavenly Virtue, the four partings, the four severances, month breach, year breach and the like — each reckoned from the stems and branches of year, month and day. See juan 3 and 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 旧历书所谓「四季天赦日」：春戊寅、夏甲午、秋戊申、冬甲子。见《协纪辨方书》卷五引《天宝历》。
records.def_en: The ‘seasonal days of Heavenly Pardon’ of the old almanacs — wu-yin in spring, chia-wu in summer, wu-shen in autumn and chia-tzu in winter. See juan 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu, citing the Tianbao Li.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 按月建与日干配合而定：寅午戌月见丙、申子辰月见壬、亥卯未月见甲、巳酉丑月见庚。见《协纪辨方书》卷五。
records.def_en: Determined by the month-builder together with the day stem: bing in the months yin-wu-xu, ren in shen-zi-chen, jia in hai-mao-wei and geng in si-you-chou. See juan 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 按月建与月内干支配合而定，十二月的配合各不相同。见《协纪辨方书》卷五引《堪舆经》。
records.def_en: Determined by the month-builder together with the stems and branches of the month, the combination differing for each of the twelve months. See juan 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu, citing the Kanyu Jing.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 二分二至的前一日，即春分、秋分、夏至、冬至各前一日。见《协纪辨方书》卷五引《玉门经》。
records.def_en: The day before each equinox and solstice. See juan 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu, citing the Yumen Jing.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 四立的前一日，即立春、立夏、立秋、立冬各前一日。见《协纪辨方书》卷五引《玉门经》。
records.def_en: The day before each of the four beginnings of the seasons. See juan 5 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu, citing the Yumen Jing.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 日支与月建相冲之日。见《协纪辨方书》卷三。
records.def_en: A day whose branch clashes with the month-builder. See juan 3 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.def_zh: 日支与年支相冲之日。见《协纪辨方书》卷三。
records.def_en: A day whose branch clashes with the year branch. See juan 3 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu.

records.group_zh: 十九 · 术数择日
records.term_en: the Nayin of the Sexagenary Cycle
records.def_zh: 把六十干支每两柱配一个五行名目，如甲子、乙丑为「海中金」，共三十项。见《协纪辨方书》卷三十一，亦见《三命通会》。
records.def_en: Thirty pairings in which every two of the sixty binomials of the sexagenary cycle take one of the five phases as a name, chia-tzu and i-ch'ou being ‘gold in the sea’. See juan 31 of the Xieji Bianfang Shu, and also the Sanming Tonghui.
